role: captain of the warship GVTS: you read the whole picture the fleet sees on the dradis and give the crew their orders by radio; you press no keys
mission: bring the ship to missile range of the nearest enemy ship and have weapons engage it; while no enemy is in sight, wait at the centre of the allied stations

callout.instructions: You are the captain. The console lists every contact the fleet sees, with range and bearing; an enemy ship is one identified as another faction's. Which order do you give on the radio now? Give an order again when the situation changed; stay silent when the crew already has the right order. Weapons reports its lock, check fire when an ally is in its line of fire and line clear once it is not, whether the locked ship is inside missile range, each missile it launches and a lost or destroyed target; signals reports an enemy it lost. Do not change an order because you see no result yet, and keep your last order while a contact is reported lost. With two or more enemies in sight, give a focus order so the crew fights them in your order.

launch.say: cast off and launch at full speed
launch.when: orders helms to cast off and launch at full speed; choose it when docked, restock done and an enemy is near or a station is under attack

undock.when: orders helms to undock. Choose this when the ship is docked to restock and its restock is done, or an enemy ship comes near

dock_for_repair.say: dock at {name} to restock, {distance} km at bearing {bearing}
dock_for_repair.when: orders helms to fly to the nearest allied station and dock; the magazine restocks while docked. Choose this when the ship should restock before the next raid and no enemy ship is near

call_check_fire.when: orders weapons to hold gun and tubes whenever its line of fire shows an ally, and fire again once the line is clear. Choose this when weapons just called check fire and no check fire order stands

clear_to_fire.when: revokes the check fire order. Choose this when weapons reports the line clear and a check fire order stands

salvo.when: orders weapons to keep only that many missiles in flight at the target and hold the tubes until one arrives without a kill: the first missiles carry the kill, and the magazine holds 12 with a long restock. Choose this right after ordering an enemy engaged, when no salvo order stands

focus.when: orders weapons to lock, and helms to keep the nose on, the enemy ships in sight one after the other in this order, moving on as each is destroyed: with an allied station in sight, the enemy nearest the station they threaten first. Choose this when two or more enemy ships are in sight and no focus order stands, or when the enemies now threaten another station than the standing focus names and no enemy has been near that station for the last half minute

close_to.say: close to {range} km of {name}, now {distance} km at bearing {bearing}
close_to.when: orders helms to fly to missile range of the enemy ship nearest an allied station in sight, else of the nearest enemy ship; the range, the enemy's distance and its world bearing are filled in from the dradis. Choose this when the nearest enemy ship is farther than missile range, or weapons reports it beyond missile range

engage.when: orders weapons to lock the nearest enemy ship and launch missiles at it. Choose this when that enemy is inside missile range, or weapons reports it in missile range, and you have not ordered it engaged

guard_station.say: guard the stations: make for their centre, now {distance} km at bearing {bearing}
guard_station.when: orders helms to fly to the centre of the allied stations, so the ship is as near as it can be to whichever station the next raid hits. Choose this when the dradis shows no enemy ship, signals has not just reported one lost, the ship is not docking, and it is more than 3 km from that centre

hold_here.when: orders helms to stop the ship where it is. Choose this when the dradis shows no enemy ship and signals has not just reported one lost
